ssh -o BatchMode=yes 10.1.1.69 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
docker run -d --name lab-2026-11-02-qwen7b-decode-batch-sweep-node0 --runtime=nvidia -e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all --ipc=host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HF_HOME="/hf" -e HOME="/tmp" -e VLLM_CACHE_ROOT="/tmp/vllm-cache" -e PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" -e CUDA_HOME="/usr/local/cuda" -v "$HOME/.cache/huggingface:/hf" -v "$HOME/inference-sim-lab:/lab" --entrypoint python3 vllm/vllm-openai:v0.29.0 /lab/bench/bench_latency.py --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct --shapes 1x512,2x512,3x512,4x512,6x512,8x512,12x512,16x512,20x512,24x512,28x512,32x512,40x512,48x512,56x512,64x512 --decode 128 --warmup 2 --iters 5 --tp 1 --pp 1 --dtype bfloat16 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 --max-model-len 4096 --max-num-batched-tokens 32768 --max-num-seqs 64 --seed 0 --output /lab/runs/2026-11-02-qwen7b-decode-batch-sweep-node0/results.jsonl
